message.content: On April 3, 2026, the bread delivery to Li Hua is being handled by Hailey Johnson. This is indicated in the conversation where HaileyJohnson mentions, "Hey! Just a quick reminder that Alice is on her way to deliver your fresh bread this morning. Enjoy! 🥖💖". Additionally, it is noted that Alice delivers the bread multiple times, as evidenced by subsequent entries such as "Alice: I am Alice from Hailey's bakery. Your bread has been delivered, please come and pick it up ASAP. Have a good day : )". Hence, Alice is the primary delivery person on this specific date, although Alice also handles other deliveries as well.
